headline: Meta open sources code to let you make Muse AI gadgets
summary: Meta has open-sourced code for its new Muse AI agent. This allows users to create custom AI gadgets. Suggested projects include AI displays for reminders or HDMI sticks for big screens.

headline: Netflix is pivoting away from prestige
summary: Netflix is shifting its strategy away from critically acclaimed prestige content. The streamer has ended multiyear production deals with noted directors. This indicates a larger strategic change in its content approach.

headline: Apple will limit Mac disk access as AI agents ‘substantially’ increase risk
summary: Apple is implementing new limits on 'full disk access' for Mac. This measure is in response to increased risks posed by AI agents. New controls aim to ensure users consciously grant extraordinary access to apps.

headline: Sling TV drops its one-day cable passes
summary: Dish-owned Sling TV has discontinued its 'Sling Pass' feature. This feature allowed users to purchase cable TV programming for a single day. Previously, day, weekend, and week-long passes were available.

headline: Former NFL Coach Mike Tomlin Is a Hardcore Minecraft Player, Reveals City He Took 12 Years to Build
summary: Former NFL coach Mike Tomlin is a dedicated Minecraft player. He recently revealed a massive in-game city he built over 12 years. Tomlin has also started a Minecraft YouTube channel.

headline: Best Buy Has the ASRock Radeon RX 9070 XT 16GB Graphics Card in Stock for $740
summary: Best Buy currently has the ASRock Radeon RX 9070 XT 16GB GPU in stock. The graphics card is available for $740. It offers performance nearly on par with the GeForce RTX 5070 Ti but for hundreds less.

headline: Disney Says Conversations About Buying Epic Games Are Not Happening 'Right Now'
summary: Disney has addressed rumors regarding a potential acquisition of Epic Games. The company states that discussions about buying the Fortnite developer are not active. This clarifies recent speculation in the gaming industry.

headline: Lanterns: Who Killed Hal Jordan and More of Our Biggest Questions Heading Into the Finale
summary: The 'Lanterns' season finale is approaching, leaving fans with many questions. Key mysteries include who killed Hal Jordan and if he is truly dead. The article explores other unanswered plot points, such as Sinestro's role.

headline: Widdecombe suspect charged with planning terror act against Farage
summary: A suspect in the Widdecombe case has been charged with planning a terror act. The alleged target of the plot was Nigel Farage. Counter-terror police confirm the charge follows an intensive investigation.

headline: G7 to release 100 million barrels of oil and diesel after Trump export ban threat
summary: The G7 nations will release 100 million barrels of oil and diesel. This coordinated action follows a threat from Donald Trump to ban US diesel exports. The move aims to prevent further price spikes in the energy market.

headline: Watch: Why has UK diesel price hit an all time high?
summary: UK diesel prices have reached an all-time high, averaging £2 per litre. Petrol prices are also currently on the rise. The article explores reasons behind this significant increase.

headline: Men charged over alleged plot to target Manchester Jewish community
summary: Two men have been charged in connection with an alleged plot. The plot reportedly aimed to target the Jewish community in Manchester. Arrests were made in the Northern Quarter on the eve of Yom Kippur.
